name: mini-saas-dashboard
description: Mini SaaS project-management dashboard — React + Express + MongoDB monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mini-saas/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mini-saas/shared" "npm run dev -w @mini-saas/api" "npm run dev -w @mini-saas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mini-saas/shared && npm run build -w @mini-saas/api && npm run build -w @mini-saas/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @mini-saas/shared && npm run seed -w @mini-saas/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mini-saas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mini-saas/api && npm run typecheck -w @mini-saas/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mini-saas/shared && npm run test -w @mini-saas/api && npm run test -w @mini-saas/web
